verdict.rationale: Browser Use Cloud documents tiered concurrency limits: 10 concurrent browsers free, 50 after a $100 top-up, and 250, 500 or 1,000 at higher spend. It also documents programmatic launch, connect and stop of cloud browsers, and session objects backed by a published OpenAPI v4 API. Missing for 10: explicit docs on orchestrating many parallel sessions (listing or bulk management of active sessions, behavior when the limit is hit), and independent or hands-on corroboration of running fleets at scale.

support.subject: As an automation-engineer, I can run a fleet of concurrent browser sessions with documented concurrency limits and programmatic session management

citations.quote: new projects get 10 concurrent browsers at $0; a $100 one-time top-up (non-expiring credits, no subscription) unlocks 50 concurrent
Launch a browser, connect to its CDP URL, then stop it
A **session** holds the agent’s conversation and can reuse its live browser. One session ID can contain multiple runs.
